blocks.text: CEBU CITY, Philippines — Two operators of modernized public utility jeepneys (PUJs) plying the 01K route have been issued show cause orders by the Land Transportation Franchising and Regulatory Board (LTFRB) following reports that their drivers allegedly refused to transport commuters under the government’s Libreng Sakay program in Cebu City.
